batch: USPS source, reference, semantic evaluator and calibration

source_check.risk: Wrong edition, unit/zone binding or transcribed price
source_check.stop: Any of 192 prices differs from official machine table

reference_and_calibration.risk: Wrong native formulas, false positives, false negatives, hidden layout coupling or parser failure treated as business error
reference_and_calibration.stop: Any declared fact loss/invariant/status assertion fails
reference_and_calibration.repair_budget: Rerun affected failing categories once after repair

hash_budget: Source import once; excerpt generation once; isolation hashes for each required dynamic test only
paid_call_gate: No approved complete provider/model/CLI and hard currency-denominated cap available
